about: FLAMINGO P_dE = P_hE/b(k) and P_EE (with errors) at the core snapshots, and the joint fits of fits/hmc_rb_fit.py at k_max = 0.52 h/Mpc (fitted to 0.05 <= k <= 0.52 at all nine snapshots at once): 1p one population, A1 ((1+z)/1.62)^eta1; 1pA the same with alpha ((1+z)/1.62)^eta_alpha; rbSbP every galaxy aligned like its host halo, alignment ~ b^beta, blue scaled by kappa_b in [0, 1] (the fit takes kappa_b = 1); rbSbA the same with alpha evolving and kappa_b free (the fit takes the bound kappa_b = 2, unphysical). chi2_snap: chi2 of each model at each snapshot over its 3 x n_k fitted points.
